businessFlow.subject: Listings rows now offer Pause (PUBLISHED), Unpublish (PUBLISHED/PAUSED), and Archive (DRAFT/PUBLISHED/PAUSED) alongside Publish/price/photos
steps: verify Pause/Unpublish/Archive buttons render per listing status
click Archive on a listing and confirm POST /api/v1/admin/listings/:id/archive returns 200
click Unpublish on a listing and confirm POST /api/v1/admin/listings/:id/unpublish returns 200

notes: Archive is a soft-delete (status -> ARCHIVED, never a hard delete because listings reference inventory + reservations/orders). Terminal RESERVED/SOLD listings cannot be archived. No console errors from the flows.
